about: A local-first personal finance app for budgeting.

prs.title: Bank files with comma decimals import the right amounts
prs.broken: Bank files in the OFX format that write amounts with a comma, as French, Belgian and Brazilian banks do, imported every amount a hundred times too big.
prs.changed: A comma is now read as the decimal mark when the amount has no dot. Amounts that already use a dot import as before.
prs.matters: People with European or Brazilian bank exports get correct transactions without fixing each one by hand.
